head: 92b26149134a01c963be1e81446b8d9b5acb8840
claim: A release publish on this branch attempts only the eight kits that still belong in @byokit (mcp, cloud, audio, dictation, infer, phone, push, signaling) and never attempts @byokit/record, overlay, statusbar, browser or bubble, which are held back with private: true

target.version: byokit release tool 2026-10-25 (the merged 27-package release at 50e246f0)

steps.start: main with 27 versions merged but only 14 published: a publish attempt stopped on @byokit/record with a 404, and five of the versions waiting behind it belong to names that moved to @platform-kits
steps: run the release tool's own publish dry run on this branch
read the gate list and the npm publish lines it prints
read the five held manifests and the pending set computed from the same rule
steps.result: the publish attempts only the eight kits that still belong in @byokit (mcp, cloud, audio, dictation, infer, phone, push, signaling); @byokit/record, overlay, statusbar, browser and bubble appear nowhere because private: true holds them back, and no version or lockfile moved
